title: 去年仅2次发射：今年目标翻6倍，火箭却供不应求？
speaker: Dave Lim

segments.en: I think it'd be a really good year if we could do eight to 12 flights this year, up from two last year.
segments.zh: 我认为如果今年能完成8到12次飞行，那将是很好的一年，而去年只有两次。

segments.en: That would be a good cadence for us. I can see a path that we have plenty of hardware to do that.
segments.zh: 这对我们来说是一个不错的节奏。我看到我们有足够的硬件来实现这个目标。

segments.en: It really is what we learn from the flights. I would tell you that there's never been a time where launch is in such demand.
segments.zh: 关键在于我们从飞行中学到什么。我要告诉你，发射需求从未像现在这样旺盛。

segments.en: And by the way, I think the demand's going up with all these direct-to-device announcements. Amazon made one, obviously, other AST is doing direct-to-device.
segments.zh: 而且，随着这些直连设备公告的发布，我认为需求还在上升。亚马逊显然也发布了，其他AST也在做直连设备。

segments.en: And the mega-constellations, we have our own constellation, we announced with TerraWave that if I could fly a rocket every week right now, I would be sold out for the indefinite future.
segments.zh: 还有巨型星座，我们有自己的星座，我们与TerraWave宣布，如果我现在能每周发射一次火箭，未来很长一段时间都会售罄。

segments.en: And so, our job is to get out there, get as fast a cadence as we can, as quickly as possible.
segments.zh: 所以，我们的任务是尽快实现尽可能快的发射节奏。

segments.en: And the foundation of that, again, is just to build a world-class manufacturing business. And that's something I've done for a long time, and the team's done for a long time.
segments.zh: 而这其中的基础，就是打造世界级的制造业务。这是我长期在做的事情，团队也长期在做。

segments.en: And I think we're on the right path. We still have a ways to go, but I'm excited about the progress.
segments.zh: 我认为我们走在正确的道路上。我们还有很长的路要走，但我对进展感到兴奋。
